description: C++23 campaign foundation with strategic clocks, canonical strategic/tactical frame routing, immutable background Player17 saves and primary/backup load recovery. The opt-in SDL3/Vulkan native galaxy preview displays a real 500-system campaign with mouse navigation, pause/speed controls and transactional Save/Load/Exit. Its runtime requires no Godot or .NET. Exports seal declared data and reviewed runtime dependencies. Production player UI, audio, colony/system screens, tactical rendering and graphical parity remain open. Diagnostic timings are not an FPS guarantee.
